metadata.description: Run multi-step Claude Code work without drift. Eleven Cowork lifecycle hooks, three chat-based keyword gates, directive-contract pre-approval, persistent file-backed run memory with SHA-256 integrity, an opt-in real-time judge, per-stage model/effort binding, an MCP Mem0 cross-session layer, scope-lock authority, DoD readiness, and a centralized stop validator. Codex stays lighter; Claude takes the heavier hand.

plugins.description: /agent-pipeline-claude:run orchestrates multi-step Claude Code work end-to-end. Eleven Cowork lifecycle hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/PermissionRequest/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/PreCompact/PostCompact/SubagentStop/Stop/SessionEnd) deny destructive commands, block out-of-scope writes during active runs, and refuse invalid pipeline stops. Three chat-based keyword gates (APPROVE/REVISE/REPLAN/BLOCK/VIEW). Persistent file-backed memory at .agent-runs/<run-id>/memory/ survives context compaction and is SHA-256 integrity-checked on reload. Optional directive-contract pre-approval (SHA-256-bound) auto-fires conformant manifest/plan gates; an opt-in real-time judge supervises risky actions before they run. /agent-pipeline-claude:mem0 manages the MCP cross-session Mem0 layer; OSS-default, Platform behind consent.
plugins.name: agent-pipeline-claude
